FuzzEditorConsistency consistency:selection-ranges:nesting:vibelang compiler LSP 3.17 ("parent.range must contain this.range"), D32: nodes synthesized for VibeLang surface forms have selection ranges that do not nest in source order; ordinary TypeScript syntax retains strict keys

FuzzEditorConsistency consistency:organize-imports:error:TS2307 compiler D372, D283: Organize Imports rewrites `import { ... } from plans`, an import of a module declaration, as `from "./main.vibe.plans.js"`, the module's internal file name, which adds TS2307; an automatic change reports no new error (Chapter 28, Rewrites keep meaning)
FuzzEditorConsistency consistency:organize-imports:error:TS2882 compiler D372, D283, D403: Organize Imports rewrites the side-effect import `import first` of a module declaration as `import "./main.vibe.first.js"`, which adds TS2882

FuzzEditorConsistency consistency:rename:FunctionDeclaration:diagnostics:TS2304 compiler LSP 3.17, D372: renaming a function leaves its call inside a retired `select` arm unrenamed (references miss it, as hover does there, D77), which adds TS2304
FuzzEditorConsistency consistency:rename:VariableDeclaration:diagnostics:TS2304 compiler LSP 3.17, D372: renaming the binding of `when let other and if (other.length > 3): ...` leaves a use of it unrenamed, which adds TS2304
FuzzEditorConsistency consistency:rename:VariableDeclaration:diagnostics:TS2339 compiler LSP 3.17, D372: renaming the binding of the pattern `when Option.Some { let value }` writes `{ let fresh }`, which reads the property `fresh` instead of `value` (TypeScript writes `value: fresh` for a shorthand binding), adding TS2339
FuzzEditorConsistency consistency:rename:Parameter:diagnostics:TS2304 compiler LSP 3.17, D372: renaming the parameter of `(error) => error is ItemMissing` leaves the operand of `is` unrenamed, which adds TS2552
FuzzEditorConsistency consistency:call-hierarchy:incoming-missing:ClassDeclaration compiler LSP 3.17: the outgoing calls of `error Sub extends Base` hold a call of Base at Sub's name, from the constructor the declaration synthesizes, which Base's incoming calls do not hold; the Effect reading's class has no such call (D32)
FuzzEditorConsistency consistency:call-hierarchy:incoming-missing:FunctionDeclaration compiler LSP 3.17: a call inside a retired `select` arm is among its function's outgoing calls but not among the callee's incoming calls, whose references miss it (D32, D77)
